title: Canada Commits Troops to Korean War Under UN
notes: 26,000 Canadians served confirmed by Veterans Affairs Canada. Canadian Army Special Force deployed 1950. Facts accurate.

title: Red River Flood Displaces 100,000 in Winnipeg
notes: 100,000 residents evacuated confirmed by Manitoba government and Wikipedia. Red River Floodway completed 1968. Facts accurate.

title: Old Age Security Act Creates Universal Pension
notes: OAS Act 1951 confirmed, universal pension for age 70+, replaced means-tested 1927 system. Facts accurate.

title: Massey Commission Recommends Federal Arts Funding
notes: Report delivered 1951, Canada Council created 1957. Facts accurate.

title: CBC Television Launches in Montreal and Toronto
notes: CBFT Montreal launched September 6, CBLT Toronto September 8, 1952. Facts accurate.

title: Richard Riot Signals Quebec Nationalist Frustration
notes: Riot March 17, 1955 following Campbell's suspension of Richard. 33 injured, property damage ~$100,000. Facts accurate.

title: Pearson's Suez Proposal Creates Modern UN Peacekeeping
notes: Pearson proposed UNEF during Suez Crisis 1956, won Nobel Peace Prize 1957. Facts accurate.

title: Pipeline Debate Parliamentary Crisis Topples Liberals
notes: Pipeline Debate 1956, Liberals defeated in 1957 election after 22 years. Facts accurate.

title: Diefenbaker Ends Twenty-Two Years of Liberal Rule
notes: Diefenbaker minority 1957, majority 1958. Indigenous voting rights extended. Facts accurate.

title: Avro Arrow Cancellation Devastates Canadian Aerospace
notes: Cancelled February 20, 1959 (Black Friday). 14,000+ jobs lost immediately. Facts accurate.

title: St. Lawrence Seaway Opens, Transforms Great Lakes Commerce
notes: Opened June 26, 1959 by Queen Elizabeth II and Eisenhower. Facts accurate.

title: Quiet Revolution Transforms Quebec Society
notes: Lesage Liberals won June 22, 1960 Quebec election. Secularization and Hydro-Quebec nationalization confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Status Indians Granted Federal Vote Without Treaty Waiver
notes: Diefenbaker extended federal vote to Status Indians without surrendering treaty rights. Facts accurate.

title: Saskatchewan Medicare Doctors' Strike Tests Universal Care
notes: 23-day strike July 1-23, 1962 confirmed. CCF government. Model for 1966 federal Medical Care Act. Facts accurate.

title: FLQ Bombings Launch Decade of Separatist Violence
notes: First FLQ attacks March 1963 in Montreal targeting military barracks. Campaign culminated in October Crisis 1970. Facts accurate.

title: Pearson Liberals Win Power, Launch Reform Decade
notes: Pearson minority 1963. Medicare, CPP, Maple Leaf flag, Official Languages Act, points-based immigration all enacted 1963-1968. Facts accurate.

title: Maple Leaf Flag Adopted as National Symbol
notes: Flag adopted February 15, 1965. Replaced Canadian Red Ensign. Great Flag Debate confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Canada-US Auto Pact Integrates North American Industry
notes: Automotive Products Trade Agreement signed 1965. Eliminated tariffs under production guarantee conditions. Facts accurate.

title: Medical Care Act Establishes National Medicare Framework
notes: Medical Care Act 1966, all provinces joined by 1972. Saskatchewan 1962 model confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Centennial and Expo 67 Mark Peak of National Confidence
notes: Expo 67 attracted over 50 million visitors, widely acclaimed. 1967 centennial confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Points-Based Immigration System Ends Racial Hierarchy
notes: 1967 Immigration Regulations (Order-in-Council PC 1967-1616) introduced points system based on education, language, employment. Ended national-origin preference. Facts accurate.

title: Trudeau-Mania Sweeps Liberals to Majority Government
notes: Trudeau Liberals won majority 1968. Just Society platform. Bilingualism, decriminalization, metric system, Charter all during his tenure. Facts accurate.

title: Parti Quebecois Founded, Sovereigntist Politics Formalised
notes: PQ founded October 14, 1968 by Levesque merging MSA and RN. Facts accurate.

title: Official Languages Act Enshrines French-English Bilingualism
notes: Official Languages Act 1969, equal status for French and English federally. Commissioner of Official Languages created. Facts accurate.

title: October Crisis — FLQ Kidnaps Politicians, War Measures Invoked
notes: Cross kidnapped October 5, Laporte October 10, murdered October 17. War Measures Act invoked, 497 arrested (event says 'over 450' — accurate). Only peacetime use confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Canada Recognises the People's Republic of China
notes: Canada recognised PRC October 13, 1970. 'Takes note of' Taiwan formula confirmed as influencing subsequent US policy. Facts accurate.

title: Multiculturalism Policy Declared — A World First
notes: Trudeau announced October 8, 1971. Canada confirmed as first country to adopt official multiculturalism policy. Canadian Multiculturalism Act 1988. Facts accurate.

title: Summit Series — Canada Defeats Soviet Union in Hockey Thriller
notes: Henderson goal with 34 seconds remaining in Game 8, September 28, 1972. Cold War framing confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: OPEC Oil Shock Exposes Canada's Energy Vulnerability
notes: 1973 Arab oil embargo, Petro-Canada created 1975, NEP 1980. Alberta-Ontario energy tensions confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Parti Quebecois Wins Quebec, Sovereignty on the Agenda
notes: PQ won majority November 1976. Bill 101 enacted. Referendum commitment. Facts accurate.

title: Bill 101 Makes French Sole Official Language of Quebec
notes: Charter of the French Language enacted 1977. French as exclusive language of Quebec government and commerce. Facts accurate.

title: Quebec Sovereignty Referendum Defeated 60-40
notes: Result was 59.56% No vs 40.44% Yes. '60-40' is a rounded approximation, not materially wrong. Trudeau's federalist campaign and renewed federalism promise confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: National Energy Program Triggers Western Alienation
notes: NEP 1980, made-in-Canada price below world levels, Canadianization. Alberta fury and western alienation well documented. Facts accurate.

title: Terry Fox Begins Marathon of Hope, Inspires Nation
notes: Started April 12, 1980. Ran 5,373 km in 143 days. Stopped in Thunder Bay when cancer spread. Died June 1981. Raised over $24 million confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Constitution Patriated — Charter of Rights Proclaimed
notes: Proclaimed April 17, 1982 by Queen Elizabeth II. Charter, Aboriginal rights recognition, amending formula all confirmed. Quebec's exclusion confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Mulroney Wins Majority, Conservatives Return to Power
notes: 211 seats September 4, 1984 confirmed as second-largest majority in Canadian history (at the time largest). FTA, GST, Meech Lake confirmed outputs. Facts accurate.

title: Air India Bombing Kills 329 in Canada's Worst Terror Attack
notes: June 23, 1985. 329 killed, 268 Canadian citizens (event says 280 — minor discrepancy; Wikipedia says 268 Canadian citizens, 27 British, 22 Indian; some sources count 280). Not materially wrong. Sikh extremist Babbar Khalsa confirmed. Facts broadly accurate.
flag: minor: event says 280 Canadian citizens; Wikipedia says 268 Canadian citizens

title: Meech Lake Accord Attempts Quebec Constitutional Integration
notes: Meech Lake 1987. Distinct society, immigration and Senate powers. Failed June 1990 via Elijah Harper and Newfoundland withdrawal. Facts accurate.

title: Free Trade Election Gives Mulroney Mandate for FTA
notes: 1988 election fought on Canada-US FTA. Conservatives won second majority. FTA in force January 1989, template for NAFTA. Facts accurate.

title: Ecole Polytechnique Massacre Galvanises Gun Control Movement
notes: December 6, 1989. 14 women killed, 14 wounded. Firearms Act 1995. December 6 as National Day confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Oka Crisis — Mohawk Land Standoff Reshapes Indigenous Policy
notes: 78-day standoff July-September 1990. Golf course expansion on burial ground. Army deployed. Mercier Bridge blockade confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Charlottetown Accord Rejected in National Referendum
notes: October 26, 1992. 54.3% No nationally. Defeated in six provinces including Quebec confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: NAFTA Framework Agreed Between Canada, US, and Mexico
notes: NAFTA framework agreed August 1992, signed December 17, 1992. In force January 1, 1994. Event year 1992 is accurate for the agreement. Facts accurate.

title: Progressive Conservatives Collapse to Two Seats in Election
notes: October 1993 election, PCs fell from 156 seats to 2. Kim Campbell lost her own seat. Chretien Liberals won majority. Reform Party and Bloc split confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Quebec Sovereignty Referendum Almost Breaks Up Canada
notes: October 30, 1995. 50.58% No vs 49.42% Yes. Margin of fewer than 55,000 votes confirmed. Clarity Act 2000 followed. Facts accurate.

title: Confederation Bridge Links PEI to Mainland — Longest in Canada
notes: Opened May 31, 1997. 12.9 km confirmed. Longest bridge over ice-covered water. Fulfilled confederation promise. Facts accurate.

title: Ice Storm Paralyses Eastern Canada for Weeks
notes: January 1998. 35 killed confirmed. Power out up to 5 weeks for millions. Event says 3 million without power; some sources say 4 million. Damage estimates vary $3-5 billion. Not materially wrong. Facts broadly accurate.

title: Nunavut Territory Created as Inuit Homeland
notes: April 1, 1999. Carved from eastern/central NWT. One-fifth of Canada confirmed. Largest Indigenous land settlement. Facts accurate.

title: Walkerton Water Crisis Kills Seven, Exposes Regulatory Failure
notes: May 2000. 7 killed, over 2,300 sickened. Harris government deregulation confirmed. O'Connor Commission. Facts accurate.

title: Canada Responds to September 11 — Operation Yellow Ribbon
notes: 226 flights diverted, 33,000 passengers. Anti-Terrorism Act enacted. Afghanistan deployment. Facts accurate.

title: Canada Declines Iraq War — Strains US Alliance
notes: Year is wrong. The event year is 2002 but the announcement was March 17, 2003. Deliberation began in 2002 but the defining public event (Chretien's announcement) was in 2003. Year off by 1.

title: SARS Outbreak Hits Toronto — WHO Travel Advisory Issued
notes: 44 Canadian deaths confirmed. Event says 'over 375' infected; Health Canada reported 251 probable cases in Canada total, but broader quarantine cases and persons monitored reached higher numbers. WHO travel advisory April 23, 2003 confirmed. Not materially wrong. Facts broadly accurate.

title: Civil Marriage Act Legalises Same-Sex Marriage Nationally
notes: Royal assent July 20, 2005. Canada was fourth country worldwide (after Netherlands, Belgium, Spain), first in Americas. Facts accurate.

title: Stephen Harper Ends Twelve Years of Liberal Government
notes: Harper minority won January 2006. Twelve years of Liberal rule ended. Sponsorship Scandal confirmed as factor. Facts accurate.

title: Harper Apology for Indian Residential Schools
notes: June 11, 2008 in House of Commons. 150,000 children confirmed. TRC established as part of settlement. Facts accurate.

title: Parliamentary Prorogation Crisis Tests Constitutional Conventions
notes: Coalition confidence challenge, prorogation granted by GG Michaelle Jean after 2-hour deliberation. Correct year and events. Facts accurate.

title: Vancouver Winter Olympics Deliver Own the Podium
notes: 14 gold medals confirmed as all-time Winter Olympics record. Sidney Crosby OT goal in hockey final confirmed. Own the Podium programme confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Harper Wins First Conservative Majority After Five Years
notes: May 2011 Conservative majority. NDP under Layton to Official Opposition. Liberals record-low third place. Layton death August 2011. Facts accurate.

title: Idle No More Movement Asserts Indigenous Rights
notes: Founded November 2012 by four Saskatchewan women in response to Bill C-45 omnibus. Round-dance flash mobs confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Justin Trudeau Wins Liberal Majority — Dramatic Comeback
notes: October 2015 Liberal majority from third place. Largest seat gain in Canadian electoral history (148 seats). Facts accurate.

title: Truth and Reconciliation Commission Calls for Action
notes: Final report December 15, 2015. 94 Calls to Action. 150,000 children. Cultural genocide label confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Carbon Pricing Framework Imposed on Reluctant Provinces
notes: 2016 announcement confirmed. $10/tonne starting 2018 rising to $50 by 2022. Federal backstop. Supreme Court upheld 2021. Facts accurate.

title: Fort McMurray Wildfire Forces Largest Evacuation in Alberta History
notes: May 2016, 88,000 evacuated, 590,000 hectares burned. Insured losses ~$3.7 billion (some sources say $3.6B USD). 2,400 buildings destroyed. Facts accurate.

title: Quebec City Mosque Shooting Kills Six in Anti-Muslim Attack
notes: January 29, 2017. Six killed, 19 wounded at Islamic Cultural Centre. Islamophobic white nationalist motivation confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Cannabis Legalised — Canada First Major Economy to Do So
notes: October 17, 2018. Second country globally (after Uruguay), first G7 nation. Facts accurate.

title: USMCA Renegotiation Preserves Core NAFTA Architecture
notes: Agreement October 2018. Chapter 19 preserved, dairy concessions made, cultural industries exemption maintained. Facts accurate.

title: COVID-19 Pandemic — CERB Provides Emergency Income Support
notes: $2,000/month to 8.9 million Canadians confirmed. $350 billion pandemic spending broadly confirmed. Vaccine rollout among fastest in OECD confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Unmarked Graves at Residential Schools Deepen Reckoning
notes: May 2021 announcement of 215 potential sites at Kamloops using GPR. Flags at half-mast for five months. Church fires confirmed. Facts accurate (noting these were GPR anomalies, not confirmed excavated remains, but the public event as described is accurate).

title: Freedom Convoy Protests Lead to Emergencies Act Invocation
notes: February 2022. Three-week Ottawa occupation. Ambassador Bridge blockade. Emergencies Act invoked February 14, first use in its history (since 1988). Bank account freezing confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Worst Wildfire Season in Canadian History Burns 18 Million Hectares
notes: 18.5 million hectares burned, confirmed as all-time Canadian and North American record. Over 232,000 displaced. Yellowknife full evacuation confirmed. Facts accurate.

title: Housing Affordability Crisis Reaches National Emergency Level
notes: CMHC 3.5 million home shortage estimate, housing costs as dominant political issue confirmed. Facts broadly accurate for 2023.

title: Trudeau Announces Resignation as Liberal Leader
notes: Year is wrong. Trudeau announced resignation on January 6, 2025, not 2024. Year off by 1.

title: Trump Tariff Threats Expose Canada's Trade Vulnerability
notes: Trump announced 25% tariff threats late 2024. Trudeau flew to Mar-a-Lago November 29, 2024. Event year 2024 is correct. Facts accurate.
